definition: Age is a subdivision of an epoch, e.g. Oxfordian Age. The chronostratigraphical equivalent is Stage.
Chron is not currently used by BGS as a geochronological rank.
Eon is the primary division of geological time, e.g. Phanerozoic Eon. The chronostratigraphical equivalent is Eonothem.
Epoch is a subdivision of a period, e.g. Late Jurassic Epoch. The chronostratigraphical equivalent is Series.
Era is a subdivision of an eon, e.g. Mesozoic Era. The chronostratigraphical equivalent is Erathem.
Marine isotope stage. Geologic Time Scale 2020, fig. 30.2.
Period is a subdivision of an era, e.g. Jurassic Period. The chronostratigraphical equivalent is System.
Series is the chronostratigraphical equivalent to Epoch.
Stage is the chronostratigraphical equivalent to Age.
Sub Age is an informal subdivision of an age. The chronostratigraphical equivalent is Substage.
Sub Epoch is an informal subdivision of an epoch, e.g. Early Pleistocene Epoch. The chronostratigraphical equivalent is Subseries.
Sub Era is an informal subdivision of an era, e.g. Early Palaeozoic.
Subperiod is a subdivision of a period, e.g. Mississippian Subperiod.
Subseries is the chronostratigraphical equivalent to Sub Epoch.
Substage is the chronostratigraphical equivalent to Sub Age.
Subsystem is the chronostratigraphical equivalent to Subperiod.
System is the chronostratigraphical equivalent to Period.
